messages:
Maria (PM): quick sync — we need a concise policy for customer pin exceptions when migrating model versions. Key Qs: default window, approval path for longer holds, and who enforces the gates?

Sam (Eng): +1. we're getting requests for 30–90 day holds from large customers. engineering worries: serving footprint, CI surface, and drift across quant/ops.

Li (ML): for quality gating, require: eval suite pass (>=95% vs baseline), no top-10 prompt regressions, and embedding similarity >=0.98 for designated critical customers before forced swap.

Anita (SRE): ops note: each pinned variant increases capacity churn and complicates autoscaling. Proposal: default exception = 30 days. 31–90 days require SRE + Eng approval with a mitigation plan. >90 days needs Exec OK. Also require a 48h canary at 2% traffic with automated monitors before wide cutover.

Ben (CS): FYI two enterprise asks: AtlasHealth (HIPAA/legal review window) and Credify (prompt update quiet period) both asked for 60-day pins.

Maria (PM): draft migration launch criteria: (1) ML eval pass (Li), (2) infra perf smoke: p50 <= baseline+20ms and p95 <= baseline+100ms (Anita), (3) cost change <= +10% or clear cost mitigation plan (Sam), (4) 7-day preview with no critical regressions called out by CS.

Sam (Eng): add automatic rollback triggers during canary: error_rate > 0.5% OR p95_latency increase > 40% -> immediate rollback.

Li (ML): add small A/B check for intent-level metrics for top-5 customers; if top intent success drops >2% (negative) we block.

Anita (SRE): i'll build a canary monitor to post alerts to #incidents and this thread when thresholds breach. deploy-bot will annotate runs.

deploy-bot: [deploy-started] canary rollout: model=redwood-gtx-13b-v4 -> 2% traffic; run_id=canary-1934567890

Sam (Eng): sample canary config (will live in infra repo):
````
canary:
  traffic_fraction: 0.02
  duration_hours: 48
  thresholds:
    latency_p95_pct_delta: 40
    error_rate_pct: 0.5
    eval_regressions_allowed: 0
````

Maria (PM): decision proposal: default 30-day pin exception. For 31–90 days require CS justification + legal/KM note if applicable + SRE/Eng approval with mitigation plan. >90 days requires Exec signoff.

Ben (CS): where should I log exceptions? i'll triage AtlasHealth and Credify today.

Sam (Eng): create PROD-OPS tickets with label `catalog-pin-exception`. Must include: customer, reason, requested_duration, migration_plan, rollback_plan, owner.

Li (ML): for pinned customers run scheduled regression evals every 7 days; if regression > threshold -> auto-notify CS + PM.

Anita (SRE): ops action items: (1) implement canary monitor + incident alerting to #incidents; (2) add deploy-bot annotation for canary runs; (3) ensure quota accounting so pinned models don't starve autoscaling for <30d exceptions.

Maria (PM): owners: Anita -> canary monitor; Sam -> ticket template + infra config; Li -> eval gating; Ben -> exception intake + comms. i'll write short policy doc and open PR in docs/ within 48h.

Ben (CS): thanks — i'll consolidate AtlasHealth + Credify asks and open the exception tickets.

deploy-bot: [deploy-finished] canary run complete: run_id=canary-1934567890 status=success duration=47h52m

Sam (Eng): canary infra metrics looked good, opening PR: https://github.com/redwood/catalog/pull/740

Li (ML): evals clear for top prompts, embedding drift ~0.6% (within gate).

Maria (PM): sounds good. next: merge PR, update PROD-OPS board, publish policy to internal docs, and notify CS/AMs. if anyone objects to the 30-day default speak up in 24h.

Anita (SRE): small ask — define "critical regression" in the doc with examples (spam increase, hallucination on financial entities, safety classifier drop). i'll add those examples.

Sam (Eng): no objections from Eng.

Ben (CS): CS 👍 will handle customer comms.

Maria (PM): thanks all — will close thread after doc PR merges.
